purpose: Record two further duplicate findings and three related-but-distinct lower-tail pairs.

findings.subject: Chemistry
findings.concept: Phenolphthalein is colourless in acidic solution and pink in alkaline solution
findings.question_a: What colour does phenolphthalein turn in an alkaline solution?
findings.question_b: Which indicator is colourless in acidic solution and turns pink in alkaline solution?
findings.reason: Both test the same phenolphthalein colour change. Existing DUP-08 retains batch 20 row 18 and holds batch 22 row 18; batch 34 row 18 is another duplicate in the same cluster.

findings.subject: Government
findings.concept: Political neutrality requires civil servants to serve impartially regardless of party
findings.question_a: Political neutrality in the civil service means officials should:
options_a: Serve the government of the day impartially
Campaign for the ruling party while on duty
findings.question_b: The principle of political neutrality requires civil servants to:
options_b: serve the government of the day impartially regardless of party affiliation
campaign for the ruling party while on duty
refuse to implement lawful government policies
contest every election as party candidates
findings.reason: Both ask for the same civil-service neutrality principle and have the same correct answer.

preserved.subject: Economics
preserved.reason: One asks what a tariff is (a tax on imports); the other asks why a government may impose an import tariff (raise import costs/protect domestic producers). These are related but distinct learning outcomes.

preserved.subject: Physics
preserved.reason: One asks which variables determine hydrostatic pressure (including density and depth); the other tests the increase in pressure with depth. Both are useful but not identical questions.

preserved.subject: Government
preserved.reason: One asks which branches share governmental functions; the other asks the purpose of separation of powers (preventing excessive concentration of power). These are related but distinct objectives.

controls.note: DUP-147 extends an existing phenolphthalein cluster; the new held row is batch 34 row 18. Tariff definition versus purpose, hydrostatic-pressure variables versus depth trend, and separation-of-powers branches versus purpose are preserved as distinct.
